CHAPTER.CAPTION: A Psalm of David, when he fled from his son Absalom.
CHAPTER.VERS: O Jehovah, how my adversaries have increased! Many are they who rise up against me.
Many are saying of my soul, There is no deliverance for him in God. Selah.
But You, O Jehovah, are a shield for me; my glory, the One who lifts up my head.
I cried unto Jehovah with my voice, and He heard me out of His holy hill. Selah.
I lay down and slept. I awoke, for Jehovah sustained me.
I am not afraid of ten thousands of people who have set themselves against me all around.
Arise, O Jehovah; deliver me, O my God; for You have struck all my enemies on the cheekbone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.
Salvation belongs to Jehovah. Your blessing is on Your people. Selah.
